test_title: PYST 28: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single digit numbers only). Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 8 1 3 4 3 5 1 8 1 9 1 2 7 1 5 8 9 7 3 8 8 2 3 3 2 1 2 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an odd number?
solution:
Given series: (Left) 8 1 3 4 3 5 1 8 1 9 1 2 7 1 5 8 9 7 3 8 8 2 3 3 2 1 2 (Right)

According to the question:

Required condition: Odd number - Even number - Odd
